items.title: Republic, WM pursue food-grade PP resin projects
items.summary: Republic plans to pursue approval for broader uses of its postconsumer PP resins produced by Blue Polymers. Meanwhile, WM inked an annual 25-million pound PP offtake deal with PureCycle, a maker of food grade resin.

items.title: Republic Services (RSG), Why Is Its Latest Update Drawing Attention?
items.summary: Republic Services (RSG) just hit a fresh 52 week high after strong pricing and revenue data, including 21% growth in its Environmental Solutions arm tied to emergency response work. Recent price action shows that momentum in Republic Services has cooled slightly in the very short term, with the 1 day share price return declining 1.49%. However, the 30 day and 90 day share price returns of 8.79% and 13.51% reflect a stronger upswing that aligns with the recent guidance raise and segment growth...

items.title: Where Does Republic Services (RSG) Value Sit After Its 92% Run?
items.summary: Republic Services has delivered a strong multi year share price run, and the question investors are now circling is whether that US$249.16 price tag is still supported by the cash the business can generate. The stock has returned 91.6% over the past 5 years, which puts a lot of expectation on the company’s ability to keep turning its waste and environmental services footprint into durable cash flows.
